rationale: dual_domain_supervised-claude-agentic: unet_c=16, epochs=44, batch_size=1, lr=0.001, optimizer=adam, lambda_neg=0.1, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=400, val_n=200, val_chunk=10, seed=42, rationale=iter-7 dual_domain_supervised, re-split Breast-CT val=200. SIX-BOX vs BEST (iter-6 c16/ep44/lr1e-3/lambda_neg1.0 hr=0.8843): (1) PRIOR: epochs lever tapering (ep32->44 +0.0186, lr5e-4->1e-3 +0.0045 -- diminishing); c=32 REGRESSED. iter-6 elapsed 1023s (~17 min, room but data-scaling at fixed epochs would breach 20-min). (2) Failure mode: hr gains flattening toward ~0.88 with epochs+lr near-tapped; a still-UNTESTED axis is the LOSS weighting -- lambda_neg=1.0 may over-suppress low-mu breast regions. (3) ONE KNOB: lambda_neg 1.0 -> 0.1 (c=16, epochs=44, lr=1e-3 all held at iter-6 winning values). Budget-neutral (same compute). (4) HYPOTHESIS: lowering the negativity-penalty weight to 0.1 lets the supervised L2 term dominate and fit true breast attenuation more faithfully -> hr above 0.8843; a cross-dataset Mayo hint flagged lambda_neg~0.1 as favorable. Expect ~0.885-0.89. If hr DROPS, the penalty was load-bearing -> revert to 1.0 and iter-8 pivots to an architecture knob (sino-branch depth). (5) BUDGET: same ep=44 -> ~1023s, inside the HARD 20-min budget (30-min wall). (6) Loop continues to iter-20. Artifacts saved to this iter dir.
